sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Spatial Magic: (the book's first page)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Spatial book; shown because the engine never hides mode 0. Not a named Langris spell.

spells.name: Spatial Magic: Archangel's Crash
spells.note: His main spell: it removes everything it touches, together with the space it is in.

spells.name: Spatial Magic: Archangel's Annihilation
spells.note: Named by the Japanese summary as the greater attack; no description was found, so the effect (three strokes of space) is inferred.

spells.name: Spatial Magic: Auto-Guard
spells.ja: 空間魔法のオートガード
spells.note: Learned after the Elf Reincarnation experience, according to the Japanese summary: spatial magic that guards him by itself.

planned.name: Fallen Angel's Descent
planned.note: A search summary of the Baidu wiki calls his ultimate this; it may be a different translation of the Archangel spells, so no page.

notes: The Spatial book's gate and portal pages belong to Finral and the other Spatial users. Langris's Archangel spells are an attack of removal, not a portal.
